description: Play this addictive game is an infinite jumper platformer with many levels and action, try it on your tablet or surface, PC also. Infinite Jumper Game, you have to go up to get Level 13th if you made it then make a Jump from that level to forget your fear. Can you make it? You have to reach Level 13 to Win. Use one finger to tap your character or use two fingers if you want, just tap the side of the screen where your player want to go. ENJOY !!!!! New weapons !! New Enemies to avoid !! Spanish language added !! New type of platforms colors to jump more !! New Leaderboard !! Live Tiles !!
